notes: Reclassified for #1980 after #1989, "fix(dsh): preserve concurrent web sessions sharing PID". The 2026-09-20 live two-TUI recording has one session-2 working-to-ready arc and no cross-session transcript removal path. The 2026-09-18 known-failing recording remains as historical regression evidence. Transcript assertions require two distinct durable session IDs with one shared cwd and the exact three targeted replies. Event assertions require two distinct PID bindings and require every removed transcript path to contain its event's session ID.

event_assertions.name: removed transcript paths belong to their sessions

text: The first real DSH UUID session appears in ready
Session 1 first exact-word prompt drives its own row to working
Session 1 binds to the process holding its own session.lock
Session 1 first completed turn returns its own row to ready
A second real DSH UUID session appears in the same cwd as a distinct session row
Session 2 first exact-word prompt drives only the second row to working
Session 2 binds to the process holding its own session.lock
Session 2 completed turn returns only the second row to ready
Session 1 is driven again while session 2 remains live, proving the original row and PID binding stay stable
Session 1 second completed turn returns the original row to ready while session 2 remains independently ready
Session 2 stays ready after its one turn while session 1 is driven again
